newsitem.title: PERU: Telefonica, miners jostle as Peru shrs end mixed.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica, miners jostle as Peru shrs end mixed.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange closed mixed Thursday as pressure to buy benchmark Telefonica del Peru was offset by profit-taking especially among mining stocks, brokers said.
They predicted light falls Friday as investors continued to reap some profits.
According to preliminary figures, the bolsa's General Index edged down 0.02 percent to 1,726.80 points while the blue-chip Selective Index advanced 0.61 percent to 2,499.25 points.
Turnover was 36 million soles ($13.5 million) on 1,823 trades.

"Telefonica attracted interest during the session because investors have good perspectives for its first quarter balances," said Lorenzo Wong, of Intercapital brokerage. The benchmark gained 1.43 percent overall to 6.39 soles.
Wong added that the mining stocks were suffering natural corrections after a previous string of rises.
Miner Milpo, for example, lost 2.16 percent to 22.70 soles, while among others Morococha dipped 2.11 percent to 2.78 soles and Atacocha held firm at 1.20 sol.
Electricity shares gained from cheap prices, with Edelnor up 2.87 percent to 2.15 soles and Edegel rising 0.82 percent to 1.23 soles.
"In general, the electricity stocks are in good shape," said Arlen Lahura, of Interlima brokerage.
